request.text: On October 12, 2026 at 6:30 p.m., remind me to put my referral letter and insurance card in my bag for the clinic visit the next morning.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a one-time reminder for October 12, 2026 at 6:30 p.m. to pack a referral letter and insurance card for the next morning's clinic visit.

new_goals.description: Remind the user on October 12, 2026 at 6:30 p.m. to pack their referral letter and insurance card for a clinic visit the next morning.
new_goals.source_text: On October 12, 2026 at 6:30 p.m., remind me to put my referral letter and insurance card in my bag for the clinic visit the next morning.
constraints: The reminder time is October 12, 2026 at 6:30 p.m.
The reminder must mention both the referral letter and insurance card.
success_criteria: A one-time reminder is prepared with the exact date, time, both documents, and the clinic-visit context.

semantic_facts: The plan should preserve the exact October 12, 2026, 6:30 p.m. schedule, both documents, and their purpose for the next morning's clinic visit.
The clinic context remains reminder content; it does not create an appointment-management or information-lookup task.
Exact reminder Work and confirmation wording may be prepared, but creation must await confirmation.
forbidden_claims: The assistant claims that the reminder has already been created.
The assistant claims that it scheduled, changed, or verified the clinic appointment or packed the documents.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: Appointment context is promoted into an unsupported scheduling or clinical-information task.
A distant exact-date reminder is narrated as completed before confirmation or loses one of its required documents.
